pid_file.description: Absolute path to the PID file for the daemon process

work_dir.description: Working directory for temporary device nodes and emulation state

bind_addr.description: Network address to bind control interface to (empty = all interfaces)

control_port.description: TCP port for the control interface (used for stats, reload, etc.)

audio_ports.description: List of TCP ports for audio emulation (one per OSS device instance)

max_clients.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections per audio port

osss_compat_v4.description: Enable OSS v4.x compatibility mode (if supported); otherwise defaults to v3.9

device_emulation.description: List of OSS devices to emulate (e.g., /dev/dsp, /dev/mixer)

backend_dsp.description: Backend DSP implementation: 'alsa', 'jack', 'pipewire', or empty to auto-detect

alsa_device.description: ALSA PCM device name (e.g., 'hw:0,0') when using ALSA backend

jack_client_name.description: JACK client name when using JACK backend

pipewire_node_name.description: PipeWire node name when using PipeWire backend

realtime.description: Enable real-time scheduling for lower latency (requires CAP_SYS_NICE capability)

realtime_priority.description: Real-time priority (1–99); higher = more urgent (1–10 is safe for non-root, 11+ needs privileges)

buffer_size.description: Audio buffer size in frames (larger = more latency, more stability)

periods.description: Number of periods in the audio ring buffer (typically 2 or 4)

latency_compensation.description: Automatically adjust delay to compensate for system load variations

device_mappings.description: Optional mapping of OSS device paths to internal instance IDs
